lines: The app ships no composer/autoload.php, so the server registers its generic loader for lib/ and looks every class up in the file system.

A composer/composer.json with config.vendor-dir ".", config.optimize-autoloader true, a config.autoloader-suffix and autoload.psr-4 {"OCA\\Cashbook\\": "../lib/"} makes composer dump-autoload write composer/autoload.php with a class map; the code of the app does not change.
vendor/ ships 1 package that the server ships itself in a major of Nextcloud 35 to 36. Both copies define the same classes, and the autoloader that is asked first decides which version runs.

2 classes implement or extend what the public API marks #[Consumable] in a major of Nextcloud 35 to 36: an app calls it, and the server may add a method to it in any release, which breaks a class that implements it.
